text: Oh, right, the zip code! Yeah, that's 85033. My name's Fatima Taylor. So, like, if you need the old Florida one, it's 32169, but I'm not giving that out. Just use the new one, okay? And my first name's Fatima, last name's Taylor. Like I said, funny how my brain just went blank on the email. But can we just get this done? I need the address fixed, and I wanna see that t-shirt! What's the cheapest one you got? Can you get that for me?
zh: 哦，对了，邮政编码！是的，那是85033。我的名字是Fatima Taylor。所以，比如，如果你需要旧的佛罗里达一个，它是32169，但我不会透露。只用新的一个，好吗？我的名字是Fatima，姓氏是Taylor。就像我说的，我的脑子怎么就突然忘了电子邮件。但我们能不能快点完成？我需要修复地址，我想看看那件T恤！你有什么最便宜的？你能帮我订购吗？
